about: Every basic food a German or English supermarket sells, by category: its English and German name and the verified row for each state people log. Scripts/check_staples.py fails when a staple has no verified row, a row lacks a name in either language, the plain names do not find the row, or the row has no typical portion. Add a category by sweeping its foods; never remove a staple to make the check pass. Convenience foods are staples only when sold sealed with a nutrition label (frozen pizzas, ready-meal trays, canned soups, instant noodles, chilled salads, shakes); their rows carry the product name ("Lasagne, ready meal"), never a bare dish name, which stays with the recipe catalogue. Takeaway and counter food (Döner, burgers, Currywurst, sushi) is never a verified row.
